clips.title: The story
paras: Grelin Whitebeard sends you east from Coldridge Valley with his report for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos. The tunnel out is overrun by troggs, and Mountaineer Thalos guards the way.

Grelin Whitebeard has documented troll activity around Coldridge Valley. After Frostmane trolls stole his journal and it was recovered, he decided the report was too important for an inexperienced apprentice to carry. He sends you directly to his brother, Senir Whitebeard, who works outside the valley in Kharanos.

The eastern tunnel is the road from Coldridge Valley to the rest of Dun Morogh, but troggs have overrun it. Mountaineer Thalos stands outside the passage to keep civilians from entering danger. He lets travelers through only when they carry urgent official business.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... Reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?
Hmm... You'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.
Speak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.
Follow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hail! Have a care, friend, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.
If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm, well, if Whitebeard is sending you to Dun Morogh on important business, I can't very well stop you, can I?
At least let me provide you with some advice and directions.
